dct_title_s: Map of a part of Washington Territory: to accompany the report of the Surveyor General, 1860-61
dct_alternative_sm: Map of a part of Washington Territory: to accompany the report of the Surveyor General, 1860-61
dct_description_sm: Shows surveys under contract, surveys executed, surveys proposed for 1861-62, Indian reservations, prairies, trails and roads, Puget Sound Co.'s claims and lighthouses and military reservations.; Relief indicated by hachures.; Signed: "James Tilton ...," Surveyor General's Office, Olympia, W.T, Sept. 20th, 1860.
